metadata.scenario: A returning customer wants to book a session for a nutrition consultation. Category: Appointment Scheduling. Outcome: appointment_booked.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is George Williams. I hope you’re doing well. Hi George! I’m doing well, thank you. How about you? I'm good, just looking to schedule a nutrition consultation. We can definitely help with that. Do you have a specific date in mind? I was thinking sometime next week, maybe Tuesday or Wednesday? Let me check the schedule for our nutritionist. Just a moment, please. Sure, take your time. I appreciate it. Alright, I see there's availability on Tuesday at 2 PM and Wednesday at 10 AM. Which works better for you? Let’s go with Tuesday at 2 PM. Great choice! I’ll book you for Tuesday at 2 PM. Thank you. Can you tell me a bit about the consultation? Of course! It will cover dietary recommendations tailored to your health needs, especially post-surgery and cardiac care. Sounds perfect. Do I need to prepare anything for the session? Just bring any recent lab results or medications you're taking. It’ll help our nutritionist provide better advice. Got it, I’ll make sure to have those ready. Excellent! Also, if you’re interested, we offer personalized meal planning as an additional service. That does sound useful. Could you send me more information about that? Absolutely, I’ll email you details about the meal planning service after this call. Perfect, I appreciate it. You're welcome, George! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? No, that’s all for now. Thank you for your help! My pleasure! I’ll see you on Tuesday at 2 PM. Looking forward to it! Have a great day, Margaret. You too, George! Take care. Bye! Bye!
